subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The DeLorean DMC-12
description: A quick win: understand The DeLorean DMC-12.

hook.text: The DeLorean is famous for time travel—in a movie. In real life, it was a beautiful disaster.

buildup.text: John DeLorean left GM to build a stainless steel sports car with gull-wing doors in Northern Ireland.

discovery.text: The brushed steel body looked stunning. But the underpowered V6 made it slower than most sedans.

twist.text: Only about 9,000 were built before the company collapsed. DeLorean was arrested in a scandal.

climax.text: Then 'Back to the Future' made it the most recognizable car in cinema history.

punchline.text: A failed car became an immortal movie star.

quiz.question: What was the DeLorean's real-life biggest problem?
options: It was too expensive to produce
